Meqabyan (Ethiopian tradition) Second Book of Meqabyan (Mäṣḥafä Mäqabyan II) (c. 600 AD)

OPENS Ch 8: MOTHER'S-EXHORTATION parallel to 4 Maccabees 15-17. The mother-of-the-five-sons exhorts her sons to martyrdom rather than apostasy. The mother-of-the-Maccabean-martyrs is one of the most theologically-developed female-figures in the Septuagint-deuterocanonical-and-Tewahedo-canonical traditions: 2 MACCABEES 7:20-29 (the canonical brief-version — 'I cannot tell how ye came into my womb... but doubtless the Creator of the world... will also of his own mercy give you breath and life again'); 4 MACCABEES 15-17 (the philosophical-extended-version — 24 chapters of philosophical praise of the mother's rational-faith). Meqabyan's distinctive feature: the mother-of-Maqabis-of-Moab's-sons is GENTILE (Moabite-converted), inverting the standard-Hebrew-mother model. The exhortation-content parallels the EOTC liturgical-praise of Mary as Mother-of-Martyrs and the Tewahedo Theotokion-tradition. Per Horovitz 1905 + CROSS_REFERENCE_APPENDIX §29: the mother-exhortation passage is among the trilogy's strongest structural-parallels to LXX-Maccabean-tradition while remaining narratively-independent of it.

Meqabyan (Ethiopian tradition) Second Book of Meqabyan (Mäṣḥafä Mäqabyan II) (c. 600 AD)

HEAVENLY-REWARD FORMULA — the mother's eschatological-promise to her sons (vv. 14-18): 'they shall reign forever with the Holy Ones; their bodies shall be like the angels; they shall behold the face of God.' The three-fold heavenly-reward formula parallels: DANIEL 12:2-3 ('they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever'); MATTHEW 22:30 par. ('in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels of God in heaven'); REVELATION 22:4 ('and they shall see his face; and his name shall be in their foreheads'); 1 JOHN 3:2 ('we shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is'); 4 MACCABEES 17:18-19 ('they stand before God's throne and live the blessed life'). The Meqabyan three-fold formula synthesizes the VISIO BEATIFICA + ANGELIC EQUALITY + ETERNAL-REIGN themes that Tewahedo eschatology systematizes — one of the most structured-ETERNAL-REWARD passages in the entire Meqabyan trilogy.
